newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Graphics says streamlining, CFO goes.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Graphics says streamlining, CFO goes.

text.p: Silicon Graphics Inc said chief financial officer Stanley Meresman is leaving the company, which also announced a reorganization Monday.

The announcement of Meresman's departure was included in a company statement announcing a reorganization aimed at streamlining operations within core businesses and aligning key resources to focus on growth markets.
A company spokeswoman said that no jobs would be eliminated as part of the reorganization. The company said that finding a replacement for Meresman was a high priority.

The new structure consolidates Silicon Graphics' primary product lines and corporate infrastructure into units. At the core of the reorganization is the creation of a single Computer Systems organization headed by Robert Ewald, former head of Silicon Graphics Cray Research unit.
This unit will include traditional Silicon Graphics computer products. Manufacturing will also move into the Computer Systems organization.

Chief executive officer Edward McCracken said transition issues experienced in getting new products out the door exposed the need to concentrate engineering and manufacturing in a single organization.
